name: Dive watch
summary: The watch for the diver. It has a steel case sealed for 100 m, a black dial with large luminous markers and a rotating bezel that counts minutes. The strap fits over a wetsuit. Two Swiss models of 1953 set the type.

philosophy.core_thesis: A diver's life depends on a clear dial and a sealed case. The watch trades slimness for a dial that is easy to read in the dark and under pressure.
design_principles: Fit a screw-down crown, a screw-down back and a gasket that seal the case to 100 m or more.
Mark the rotating bezel in minutes from 0 to 60. Let it turn only against the clock, so that a knock shortens the time shown.
Paint the markers and hands with luminous paint in big, plain shapes on a matt black dial.
Make the case 38 to 42 mm wide and 12 to 15 mm thick, with a bezel that a gloved hand can turn.
Fit a domed acrylic crystal, so that the crystal does not crack under pressure.
Mark the 12 with a triangle or a double marker, so that the diver finds the top at once.
Print the depth rating on the dial.
Fit a strap that goes over a wetsuit sleeve, as a bracelet with an extension or a rubber strap of 200 to 250 mm.
anti_patterns: A thin case with a flat glass
A gold case or an enamel dial
A bezel that turns both ways
Thin hands and small markers that do not glow
A pale or gold dial that glares
A leather strap that rots in salt water

silhouette.shape: A thick round steel case with a knurled rotating bezel, a screw-down crown with guards and a bracelet or strap.
silhouette.line: A strong circle with a deep band, a bold bezel and short thick lugs.
silhouette.fit: The watch sits high on the wrist and the strap lengthens to fit over a wetsuit.
silhouette.proportion: Case thickness to width about 1 to 3; the dial fills about 70 per cent of the face; the bezel is about 5 mm wide.
rules: Make the bezel grip with 60 notches, so that a glove can turn it.
Set a large round marker at each hour and a triangle at 12.
Make the hour hand wide and the minute hand long, both with luminous fill.
Guard the crown with a shoulder on the case so that a knock does not bend the stem.

fabrics.rule: Use steel for the case, a dark insert for the bezel, a domed crystal for the glass, and rubber, steel or canvas for the strap. Later models use sapphire, ceramic and titanium.

methods: rotating bezel with a click per minute
steel bracelet with a diver extension
construction.closures: A folding clasp with an extension closes the bracelet; a screw-down crown winds the watch and seals the case.
construction.details: A minute scale on the bezel, a triangle at 12, a depth rating on the dial and thick baton hands.

surface.pattern: A matt black dial with round markers; a black bezel insert with a luminous pip at 12.
surface.gloss: Brushed steel at 15 to 40 GU; the dial at 2 to 5 GU; the crystal and the bezel insert at 70 to 95 GU.
surface.wear: The steel scratches and the bezel insert fades to grey; the luminous paint ages to cream; rubber stiffens in the sun and is renewed.

palette.strategy: Black and white for reading, steel for the case, and one signal colour for the seconds hand or the first 15 minutes of the bezel.

processes: gasket test in a pressure tank
making.scale: Swiss factory output of thousands a year; each watch passed a pressure test before it left the factory.
making.signs: A knurled bezel, a guarded screw-down crown, a black dial with large markers and a depth rating.

pieces.form: Steel case with a screw-down crown and a rotating bezel
Riveted steel bracelet with a folding clasp and extension
Black bezel insert with a luminous pip at 12
Domed crystal over a black dial
Ribbed rubber strap that fits over a wetsuit
Sailcloth canvas strap with a pin buckle

positive: black dial with round luminous markers

emotion.target_response: A sense of safe depth: the viewer sees a heavy case, a black face and a glow that will work in the dark.

use_cases: a prop for an ocean or a naval film
an image prompt for a diver's watch on a wrist
avoid_when: the brief wants a thin dress watch
the brief wants gold and enamel
the brief wants a smart or digital display

modifiers.request: for the road and the track
modifiers.how: Add two chronograph pushers and a tachymeter bezel, and thin the case to 14 mm.
Cast an integrated steel bracelet, polish the bevels, add a gold or a steel bezel, and keep 100 m of water resistance.
